name: example-nested-note
title: Nested note demo
description: A demonstration of what specVersion 30 opened: a node plans the note's sections, a loop drafts each section by first outlining it and then running an inner loop over that outline's points, one paragraph per point; a let counts the sections with no model call; and a while redrafts the opening summary until a judge holding a house style the drafter is not told calls it good, at most three times. Sections are named by their title. Not intended for clinical use.
